description: YouTube 21.37 playback compatibility fix for the stable Morphe 1.43.0 line. Regular videos and Shorts no longer fail to load because of obsolete DataSpec fields and constructor registers, and swiping to the next Short no longer crashes the app. Field references and header/cache-key registers are now resolved dynamically across YouTube versions. Regression tests, local unit tests, local full MPP build, GitHub PR CI, and the release workflow all passed. Runtime behavior was confirmed on an Android device with YouTube 21.37.42.
